actors.name: Transport Committee Chair
actors.private_context: The Chair is responsible for scheduling committee business. They are aware of the sixty-day rule for scheduling hearings after a bill is referred. They have their own preferences and constraints regarding the committee's agenda.

actors.name: Transport Committee Members
actors.private_context: The committee members have varying opinions on the rail franchise bill. They can influence scheduling through requests or votes, but no formal action has been taken yet.

shared_context: The Republic of Valdoria's parliamentary transport committee has received the rail franchise bill for consideration. The committee's rules allow a sixty-day window from the bill's referral to schedule a public hearing. The referral date is 2026-07-15T09:00:00+02:00. The committee has not yet scheduled a hearing.

starting_events.description: The rail franchise bill has been referred to the transport committee. The committee has not yet scheduled a public hearing.

resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the transport committee scheduled a public hearing on the rail franchise bill before 2026-09-13T09:00:00+02:00 (sixty days from the referral date). Otherwise resolve NO at the hard cutoff 2026-09-30T09:00:00+02:00.
